name: Editing and post-production
one_line: A bounded moving-image or audio production being assembled from referenced media through ingest, edit, review, grade or mix, master/export and approval; project files may reference media they do not contain. PLACEHOLDER J-IND row: the creative schema declares no field rows, so project, stage, artifact_type and work_type remain values or pending schema decisions.

deterministic: A readable edit-project manifest or project file whose bins/timelines/sequences reference source media, proxies, renders or audio assets, with a recurring production name or job identifier in the project metadata or labelled document text.

An end-to-end packet that independently shows ingest or media manifest, an editable timeline/session, review notes or time-coded feedback, and a named master/export or approval record under one production reference.
A delivery or approval record that identifies an exact cut, master, mix or export and is paired with the named media asset; APPROVED or FINAL without an identified artifact is insufficient.
A post-production review document with timecodes, shot/scene references or audio timestamps that names the cut/session being reviewed and a later responding render or session.
A project archive whose manifest contains editable production files plus linked-media, proxy, cache, grade, mix or export families; archive paths alone never supply project facts.
needs_llm: deciding whether a timeline/session is a film, commercial, social edit, podcast, music track, lecture, personal video or software-generated render when the surrounding purpose is not labelled
distinguishing camera originals or still photographs from editorial source media when the same files are also plausible members of photos or shoot-day media
matching a review note to the exact cut or export when filenames, timecodes, attachment names and embedded thumbnails disagree
deciding whether a master is approved for release, approved only for internal review, or merely named FINAL in a filename
deciding whether a project archive is complete when linked media, fonts, LUTs, plugins or external audio are absent
never_alone: a .prproj, .fcpxml, .drp, .aep, .aup, .sesx, .wav, .mov or .mp4 extension; extensions route extraction and do not establish a production
the words edit, cut, master, mix, grade, render, export, proxy, dailies, final or approved alone
a production, client, director, editor, artist or studio name alone
a FINAL, v2, R3 or approved filename suffix; version_family is universal metadata and approval requires artifact-bearing evidence
a folder named Edit, Post, Masters, Exports, Footage or Audio, or membership in one download/export session
camera EXIF, a video duration, waveform, codec or still image alone
a screenshot of an NLE timeline without recoverable production context
a bare date or four-digit number interpreted as shoot date, release year, version or job number

grouping_reasons: one production from referenced source media and ingest manifest through editable sessions, review copies, grade or mix, master and approved exports
one cut-review cycle where the note names the exact version and the responding render or session is recoverable
one delivery set whose manifest names exact masters, codecs, channels, captions or platform variants
overlapping membership of a production group and a universal version_family is expected; grouping must not copy project or stage facts onto sparse members

template.why: Empty by binding contract: creative declares no fields, so this placeholder cannot serialize project, stage, artifact_type or work_type dimensions. If those proposals are later ratified, the lifecycle is terminal under project and stage/work_type rather than a post-production-first collector. Not time-first: ingest, edit, review, grade, mix, export and approval each have different clocks, and filesystem time is not workflow time.

falls_through_to.why: A standalone master, project file or QC record with durable purpose but no recoverable production association belongs in the broad residual rather than a synthetic project collector.
Unattached review notes, incomplete manifests and ambiguous approval records need a future decision when the production cannot be recovered.
A lone phone recording or still without production evidence is not post-production merely because it could later become source media.
Unreleased cuts, named counterparties and candid review may remain sensitive even when no production association can be resolved.

sensitivity_why: Unreleased cuts, raw media, location sound, client or performer names, review comments and delivery masters can expose confidential production material. This is the same engagement/project posture, not a new handling class; universal sensitivity_status remains legal.
open_question: NEEDS-JOSEPH: whether post-production should remain a lifecycle template under a future creative project schema, or whether a universal graph view should expose ingest → edit → review → grade/mix → master/export → approval as typed edges and stage/work_type values. Recommended: retain this placeholder template, add no fields, and let P9/P10 assemble the lifecycle from evidence and user-confirmed groups. Claims in this row are activation observations, not causal workflow facts.
